name: Line Following in Bounds
hint: The line-following sensor reports the four states 0 through 3 for its possible black-and-white combinations.
instruction: Map states 0, 1, 2, and 3 to the intended behaviours, and treat other readings as invalid input.

examples.label: Example
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
if <(@mBot line follower sensor [port2 v] value :: sensing) = (1)> then
say [Line detected]
end
